visualCharacteristics.purpose: Horizontal promotional strip: icon or image, heading, short text and a link or button

contentPattern.structure: One row; cells in order: icon/image (optional) | heading (or bold text) | text (optional) | link or button (optional). Cells are classified by content so any may be omitted

usage: Cross-sell and support strips between sections (40+ pages). Background colour comes from section metadata Style, not the block.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for the same content pattern; background colour comes from section metadata Style (forest, green, bright-green, eggshell, neon, white, black).
